## Overview

`ifc-step` — IFC adaptation over generic ISO 10303-21 syntax.

Generic tokenization, escaping, records, parameters, sections, parsing,
writing, partitioning, spans, diagnostics, and event sinks live in
`openbim_step`. This crate owns only conversion between that generic
substrate and `ifc_model::Model` plus IFC codec detection and I/O policy.

| Module | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `codec` | `StepCodec`/`StepReader`: detection, parse policy, I/O |
| `error` | STEP-specific failure modes, `ReadFailure` |
| `location` | Lines, columns and quotes of the source: `SyntaxLocation`, diagnostics |
| `parser` | Generic exchange to IFC record model |
| `writer` | IFC record model to physical file |

## Changes

Latest release, 0.6.4 (2026-11-04):

### Changed (#627)

- Require `openbim-step` 0.11.3. A skipped record's diagnostic names the id
  the substrate read (`Diagnostic::instance`) instead of reading it from the
  record's bytes. It now names that id also when a record that was read holds
  it (a damaged duplicate, or the rest of a record cut at a `;`), where it
  named none before. A skip that swallowed several records still names only
  the first (openbimrs/step#20, #668).
  A diagnostic may therefore name an id a kept record also holds; a
  consumer must not treat such a diagnostic as harmless.

Semver: patch
